ficha_publicada.complicacoes: Addiction: Jonah enjoys having a drink a bit more than he ought to. Honor: Hex has a personal code of honor that compels him to help and avenge the innocent. This often gets him involved in things he says he’d rather steer clear of. Prejudice: Jonah was given the mark of the demon—a very distinctive scar—by the Apache, which makes him very recognizable and more than a little ugly. He has a hard time going unnoticed even when he wants to.
